items.name: address-display
items.title: Address Display
items.description: Displays a shortened blockchain address with optional copy-to-clipboard support.

items.name: connect-wallet-btn
items.title: Wallet Connect Button
items.description: Connects a Solana wallet and displays the current connection state.
items.docs: Requires a Solana Wallet Adapter provider in the application tree. This item also installs a Next.js App Router route at app/api/wallet-account/route.ts.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Reusable button component with variants, sizes, and accessible interaction states.

items.name: nft-card
items.title: NFT Card
items.description: Displays NFT artwork, metadata, pricing, and actions in a reusable card.

items.name: nft-card-collection
items.title: NFT Card Collection
items.description: Displays collection artwork, stats, description, and item previews in a reusable card.

items.name: coin-price
items.title: Coin Price Tooltip
items.description: Shows a token price summary with optional trend details in a tooltip.
items.docs: Requires Next.js App Router. Add a CoinGecko Demo or Pro API key to COINGECKO_API_KEY. Set COINGECKO_API_PLAN=pro when using a Pro key.

items.name: token-swap
items.title: Token Swap Card
items.description: Provides a token swap interface with token inputs, slippage options, and confirmation states.

items.name: status-badge
items.title: Status Badge
items.description: Displays network or service status with configurable labels and visual indicators.

items.name: use-token-balance
items.title: useTokenBalance
items.description: Fetches, aggregates, and refreshes precise SPL token balances for a wallet and mint.

items.name: use-transaction-simulation
items.title: useTransactionSimulation
items.description: Simulates Solana transactions before requesting a wallet signature.

items.name: use-smart-retry
items.title: useSmartRetry
items.description: Retries asynchronous Solana operations with configurable backoff and error handling.

items.name: use-transaction-status
items.title: useTransactionStatus
items.description: Tracks a Solana transaction signature and exposes confirmation state.

items.name: use-private-payment
items.title: usePrivatePayment
items.description: Typed React hook for the MagicBlock Private Payments API with auth-aware requests, transaction builders, balance readers, and mint initialization checks.

items.name: use-optimistic-transaction
items.title: useOptimisticTransaction
items.description: Manages optimistic transaction state with confirmation and rollback handling.

items.name: quick-send-flow
items.title: Quick Send Flow
items.description: Drop-in SOL send flow with recipient validation, transfer review, wallet approval states, retry handling, and an explorer receipt.

items.name: private-transfer
items.title: Private Transfer Template
items.description: Standalone devnet USDC private payment template with wallet connect, mint initialization, wallet signing, submission, and confirmation.
items.docs: Requires Next.js App Router. Includes a configurable Solana Wallet Adapter provider and is configured for devnet USDC and MagicBlock Private Payments.
